name: Suitcase Carry
research: Same walking step as farmers_walk (root lowered 0.02 to z 0.951; front ankle 0.155 m ahead of the hip, flat, knee ~13 deg; back ankle 0.165 m behind, heel up 15 deg -> ankle z 0.014 + 0.094 = 0.108, knee ~33-36 deg; picture 2 swaps legs). One dumbbell, left hand: elev 10 out to the side, elbow 5, palm in (plates clear the thigh). Right arm free, no prop: elev 12, plane 10, elbow 10, relaxed. Trunk upright and level, no lean toward the weight (library step 2). EMG: S2 McGill 2013, opposite-side external oblique 47.3 % MVC with 30 kg in one hand vs 3.9 % split; S1 McGill 2009 suitcase carries. Camera yaw +40 (front, dumbbell side) so the level shoulders, the dumbbell and the step all read. Facts: research/suitcase_carry.json.
